requested_by: Tyler: 'Defensive points per play x opposite team average offense plays run, offensive points per play x offense team average plays run. Calculate for both teams, average together to determine total.'
data: CFBD games (points) + CFBD stats/game/advanced (offense.plays per team-game), 2014-2026 regular + postseason; closing and opening totals from CFBD lines (first available of DraftKings, ESPN Bet, Bovada, consensus, else median of providers: cfbpred.data.PREFERRED_PROVIDERS)

definitions.season_to_date: only games of the same season with an earlier kickoff than the game being projected (no carry-over from last season)
definitions.OPPP: points scored / own offensive plays, season to date
definitions.DPPP: points allowed / opponent offensive plays, season to date
definitions.PLAYS: average own offensive plays per game, season to date
definitions.team_points: A = average of (OPPP_A x PLAYS_A) and (DPPP_B x PLAYS_A); B the same way
definitions.eligible_games: FBS vs FBS, both teams with >= 3 earlier games this season that have play counts, closing total available

tests.T1_accuracy: mean absolute error of the projection vs the actual total, next to the closing total's MAE (information only)
tests.T2_new_information: regress (actual - close) on (projection - close); sign taken from development; PASS if the holdout one-sided p < 0.05
tests.T3_bet_rule: over when projection - close >= k, under when <= -k; k chosen on development from {0,3,5,7,10} (highest win rate with >= 200 bets); PASS if the holdout win rate at that k > 52.38% (break-even at -110) with one-sided binomial p < 0.05, pushes excluded
tests.secondary_info: the same T3 rule against the OPENING total (what an early-week bettor could get); reported, not used to pass

pass_means: the strategy becomes a candidate for a new pre-registered college paper track; nothing bets from this test
do_not_edit: do not change after seeing results; a different version = new file
